claims.plain_claim: The root program pays a withdrawal only after an on-chain Groth16 proof over eight public inputs verifies.
authority_assumptions: Upgrade authority 4cTBfB8vJK8YiCBcVrvZV4wx89AFzGEbm7LLghJsNUyD (devnet) can replace the program.
Single-party development trusted setup for circuits/null_proof_final.zkey.
claims.test_command: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test && npm run test:proof && npm run release:verify

test_run.environment: node:22 container, network off after npm ci --ignore-scripts, commit 17e44f4
test_run.command: npm test && npm run test:proof && npm run release:verify
test_run.note: npm test 158 of 158 node tests plus repo checks; test:proof 10 of 10; release:verify passed. cargo test not run in this pass.

demonstrated_properties: verifier: groth16-solana Groth16Verifier over the alt_bn128 syscalls with the embedded VERIFYING_KEY (vk.json SHA-256 6abfff44...3d63a)
circuit, zkey, wasm and vk.json pinned by SHA-256 in MANIFEST.json
devnet transaction 3wXv6wGS... (slot 487904628) invoked this program ID and succeeded
not_demonstrated: that the current devnet bytes are the build that ran 3wXv6wGS...: the program was last deployed at slot 487918755, after that transaction
a reproducible build hash binding devnet bytes to this commit
operational_limitations: Anchor.toml [programs.devnet] lists only paradox; the closed whisper and ghost_mint devnet entries were removed on 2026-10-06.

claims.plain_claim: prepare_phantom_withdraw_v2 binds the proof to the amount, receiver token account and mint.

test_run.environment: node:22 container, network off after npm ci --ignore-scripts, commit 17e44f4
test_run.command: npm test && npm run test:proof && npm run release:verify
test_run.note: npm test 158 of 158 node tests plus repo checks; test:proof 10 of 10; release:verify passed. cargo test not run in this pass.

demonstrated_properties: amount, receiver token account and mint are public inputs 3 to 7; a proof for one destination does not verify for another
commitment accounting refuses a withdrawal above the amount deposited against the commitment
not_demonstrated: hiding of amount, receiver or mint: these are public by construction (see docs/PRIVACY_PROPERTIES.md)

claims.plain_claim: Which deposit and withdrawal fields an on-chain observer can see, and which properties the prototype protects.
authority_assumptions: Groth16 soundness, and the single setup participant discarded its toxic waste.

test_run.environment: node:22 container, network off after npm ci --ignore-scripts, commit 17e44f4
test_run.note: tests/privacy-linkage.test.mjs passed within npm test; the Rust harness (cargo test --test privacy_linkage) was not run in this pass.

mocks_or_skips: The Rust harness writes initialize-time accounts directly; deposits, root update and withdrawal run through the program entrypoint without a validator.
demonstrated_properties: possession of a deposited note opening is required to withdraw
note secrets stay private witness inputs
not_demonstrated: deposit to withdrawal unlinkability: the withdrawal's public input 0 equals the deposit commitment, so the spent deposit is identifiable
an anonymity set: a depth-7 tree has 128 leaf positions, which is capacity, not a measured set
operational_limitations: Describe the current path as a devnet proof-verified withdrawal prototype with public payout fields.
